functions.build_identity:
def build_identity(context):
    build = json.loads((ROOT / "build/hq-stage2/result.json").read_text())
    require(build.get("status") == "SIMULATOR_BUILD_FOR_REAL_UI_PASS"
            and build.get("checkout_sha") == context["checkout_sha"], "No authentic same-checkout app/UI test build")
    original = runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / "Scripts/CI/hq-stage2-focused-apple.py"))
    original["verify_actual_sources"](build)
    qualified_sdk = verify_qualified_sdk(build)
    products = ROOT / "build/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator"
    bundles = [products / "Maktabah.app", products / "Maktabah-iOSUITests-Runner.app",
               products / "Maktabah-iOSUITests-Runner.app/PlugIns/Maktabah-iOSUITests.xctest"]
    binary_records = {}
    dwarf_uuids = {}
    for bundle in bundles:
        info = plistlib.loads((bundle / "Info.plist").read_bytes())
        binary_records[str(bundle.relative_to(ROOT))] = witness(bundle / info["CFBundleExecutable"])
        dwarf_uuids[str(bundle.relative_to(ROOT))] = command(["xcrun", "dwarfdump", "--uuid", str(bundle / info["CFBundleExecutable"])]).stdout
        require(re.search(r"UUID: [0-9A-Fa-f-]{36}", dwarf_uuids[str(bundle.relative_to(ROOT))]) is not None, "Actual Mach-O symbol identity missing")
    test_runs = sorted(products.parent.glob("*.xctestrun"))
    require(len(test_runs) == 1, "Exactly one original same-build xctestrun is required")
    result = {"built_binaries": binary_records, "actual_macho_dwarf_uuids": dwarf_uuids, "xctestrun": witness(test_runs[0]),
              "build_receipt": witness(ROOT / "build/hq-stage2/result.json"), "qualified_sdk_route": qualified_sdk,
              "complete_native_images": runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / "Scripts/CI/mac-prepared-inputs.py"))["code_images"](ROOT)}
    write(OUT / "actual-built-inputs.json", result)
    return products, test_runs[0], result
functions.verify_qualified_sdk:
def verify_qualified_sdk(build):
    routes = build.get("original_editor_routes")
    require(isinstance(routes, dict), "Full-v32 observations require the final qualified original SDK routes")
    app = ROOT / "build/DerivedData/Build/Products/Debug-iphonesimulator/Maktabah.app"
    # The original build already executed symbol/runtime ownership checks.
    # Revalidate their exact code/resources/signatures without recompilation.
    return runpy.run_path(str(ROOT / "Scripts/CI/original_editor_sdk_routes.py"))["verify"](
        ROOT, routes["path"], "Debug", "iphonesimulator", app, route_sha256=routes["sha256"], after_ui=True)

functions.verify:
def verify(root, route_path, configuration, platform, app, *, route_sha256, after_ui=False, after_archive=False):
    row, admitted = admitted_route(root, route_path, route_sha256, configuration, platform)
    if platform == 'iphoneos':
        require(not after_ui, 'Device compiler/archive verification cannot claim a Simulator UI phase')
        module = runpy.run_path(str(Path(root) / 'Scripts/CI/original_editor_device_signature.py'))
        verified = module['verify'](root, Path(root) / row['path'], row['sha256'], app, Path(root) / row['evidence'],
                                    expected_team=admitted['signing_team_id'], after_archive=after_archive)
        directory = Path(root) / row['evidence'] / ('device-archive' if after_archive else 'device-build')
        directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        api = sdk_api(root)
        shared = runpy.run_path(str(Path(root) / 'Scripts/CI/original_editor_shared_runtime.py'))
        shared['verify_app_ownership'](Path(root), admitted, Path(app), directory, api['command'],
            host_library_files=verified['host_build_products']['host_libraries'])
        policy = admitted['shared_package_policy']
        if policy['swift_syntax_requires_actual_runtime_absence']:
            api['verify_absence_receipt'](Path(root), Path(root) / admitted['distribution_root'],
                                         policy['producer_runtime_absence'])
            proof = api['runtime_absence_proof'](Path(root), Path(app), directory / 'swift-syntax-app')
            api['write'](directory / 'swift-syntax-runtime-absence.json', {
                'status': 'EXACT_REVIEWED_BUILD_TOOL_PAIR_WITH_ACTUAL_RUNTIME_ABSENCE',
                'sdk': policy['producer_runtime_absence'], 'app': proof, 'device_runtime': 'NOT_RUN'})
    else:
        require(not after_archive, 'Simulator route cannot grant device archive verification')
        sdk_api(root)['verify_built_app'](root, admitted, app, Path(root) / row['evidence'], after_ui=after_ui)
    return {'status': 'ACTUAL_BUILT_APP_SDK_ROUTE_VERIFIED', 'configuration': configuration, 'platform': platform,
            'sdk_source_sha': admitted['source_sha'], 'admission_sha256': admitted['admission_sha256'],
            'after_ui': after_ui, 'after_archive': after_archive, 'native_editor_ui_credit': False}

original-sdk-route.admitted_route:
def admitted_route(root, route_path, route_sha256, configuration, platform):
    root = Path(root)
    path = owned(root, route_path, 'build/')
    require(re.fullmatch(r'[a-f0-9]{64}', route_sha256) and digest(path) == route_sha256,
            'Generated original SDK route receipt changed')
    receipt = json.loads(path.read_bytes())
    routes = load(root)
    require(receipt.get('schema') == 'otzaria.original-editor.admitted-build-routes/1'
            and receipt.get('manifest_path') == routes['manifest_path']
            and receipt.get('manifest_sha256') == routes['manifest_sha256']
            and receipt.get('sdk_source_sha') == routes['sdk_source_sha']
            and receipt.get('native_source_tree') == routes['native_source_tree']
            and receipt.get('signing_team_id') == routes['signing_team_id']
            and set(receipt.get('routes', {})) == set(VARIANTS), 'SDK admission routes differ from committed source')
    selected = select(routes, configuration, platform)
    name = next(key for key, pair in VARIANTS.items() if pair == (configuration, platform))
    row = receipt['routes'][name]
    require(row['admission_path'] == selected['admission_path']
            and row['admission_sha256'] == selected['admission_sha256']
            and (row['configuration'], row['platform']) == (configuration, platform),
            'Selected app route points to another SDK variant')
    admission_path = owned(root, row['path'], 'build/')
    require(digest(admission_path) == row['sha256'], 'Actual SDK admission bytes changed')
    admitted = json.loads(admission_path.read_bytes())
    require(admitted.get('admission_path') == row['admission_path']
            and admitted.get('admission_sha256') == row['admission_sha256']
            and admitted.get('source_sha') == routes['sdk_source_sha'],
            'SDK consumer receipt does not bind the selected committed input')
    return row, admitted

functions.verify_built_app:
def verify_built_app(root, admitted, app, evidence, *, after_ui=False):
    root, evidence = Path(root), Path(evidence)
    app = app_bundle(root, app)
    require_unchanged(root, admitted)
    embedding = read_json(evidence / "app-embedding.json")
    original_app = Path(embedding["target"])
    app_layout = app.relative_to(root).parts
    require(embedding["status"] == "EXACT_PRODUCTS_PRESENT"
            and embedding["overwritten_products"] == 0
            and embedding["codesign_on_copy"] is False
            and embedding["remove_headers_on_copy"] is False
            and (original_app == app or (after_ui and original_app.is_absolute()
                 and ".." not in original_app.parts and original_app.parts[-len(app_layout):] == app_layout)),
            "Original app embed phase did not execute for the exact product layout")
    product_receipts = {(row["kind"], row["name"]): row for row in embedding["products"]}
    expected_products = {("Frameworks", name) for name in admitted["dynamic_frameworks"]}
    expected_products.update(("Bundles", name) for name in admitted["resource_bundles"])
    require(set(product_receipts) == expected_products
            and len(product_receipts) == len(embedding["products"]),
            "Original app embed product inventory differs")
    distribution = root / admitted["distribution_root"]
    prefix = "after-ui-" if after_ui else ""
    for index, name in enumerate(admitted["dynamic_frameworks"]):
        target = app / "Frameworks" / name
        require(inventory(target, metadata=True) == inventory(distribution / "Frameworks" / name, metadata=True)
                == product_receipts["Frameworks", name]["files"],
                "Embedded original framework changed: " + name)
        command(["codesign", "--verify", "--strict", str(target)], root=root, evidence=evidence,
                label=prefix + "embedded-sdk-signature-" + str(index))
    for name in admitted["resource_bundles"]:
        require(inventory(app / name, metadata=True) == inventory(distribution / "Bundles" / name, metadata=True)
                == product_receipts["Bundles", name]["files"],
                "Embedded original resource bundle changed: " + name)
    command(["codesign", "--verify", "--strict", str(app)], root=root, evidence=evidence, label=prefix + "actual-app-signature")
    policy = admitted["shared_package_policy"]
    if policy["swift_syntax_requires_actual_runtime_absence"]:
        sdk_proof = policy["producer_runtime_absence"]
        verify_absence_receipt(root, distribution, sdk_proof)
        # This directory is Simulator-only; the original macOS macro targets
        # and their separately verified pins/authorization remain untouched.
        expected_configuration = ("Release" if admitted.get("schema") == "otzaria.original-editor.production-admission/1" else "Debug")
        require(app.parent.name == expected_configuration + "-iphonesimulator", "Wrong actual Simulator product directory")
        require_no_syntax_names(path.relative_to(app.parent).as_posix() for path in app.parent.rglob("*"))
        if after_ui:
            if "consumer_runtime_absence" not in admitted:
                retained = read_json(evidence / "swift-syntax-runtime-absence.json")
                require(retained.get("status") == "EXACT_REVIEWED_BUILD_TOOL_PAIR_WITH_ACTUAL_RUNTIME_ABSENCE"
                        and retained.get("sdk") == sdk_proof, "Retained built-app runtime proof differs")
                admitted["consumer_runtime_absence"] = retained["app"]
            verify_absence_receipt(root, app, admitted["consumer_runtime_absence"], reused=sdk_proof,
                                   observed_app=original_app)
        else:
            admitted["consumer_runtime_absence"] = runtime_absence_proof(
                root, app, evidence / "swift-syntax-app", reused=sdk_proof)
        write(evidence / (prefix + "swift-syntax-runtime-absence.json"), {
            "status": "EXACT_REVIEWED_BUILD_TOOL_PAIR_WITH_ACTUAL_RUNTIME_ABSENCE",
            "maktabah_revision": SYNTAX_APP, "sdk_revision": SYNTAX_SDK,
            "sdk": sdk_proof, "app": admitted["consumer_runtime_absence"],
            "new_native_execution": False, "lock_or_macro_inputs_changed": False})
    if admitted.get("schema") in {3, "otzaria.original-editor.production-admission/1"}:
        shared = runpy.run_path(str(owned_path(root, "Scripts/CI/original_editor_shared_runtime.py")))
        shared["verify_app_ownership"](root, admitted, app, evidence, command, after_ui=after_ui)
    write(evidence / (prefix + "built-app-distribution-verification.json"), {"status": "EXACT_ORIGINAL_DISTRIBUTION_EMBEDDED",
          "dynamic_frameworks": admitted["dynamic_frameworks"], "resource_bundles": admitted["resource_bundles"],
          "native_editor_ui_tests": 0, "production_or_device_qualification": False})
